glossary.label: What is DARVO?
glossary.body: DARVO (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim & Offender) is a manipulation tactic where an abuser denies their behavior, attacks the person confronting them, and flips the narrative to make themselves look like the actual victim.

steps.quote: I was only joking around, I didn't mean anything by it.
Are you saying I don't support you?
Now I feel like I'm the bad blobfriend…

glossary.note: Notice how it ended: Violet was the one who got hurt, but Violet is the one who apologized.
